Average body mass by species (after cleaning, 70 rows used):
- Adelie: 3,702.9 g (~3.70 kg)
- Chinstrap: 3,853.1 g (~3.85 kg)
- Gentoo: 5,147.5 g (~5.15 kg)

Data problems found and fixed:
1. body_mass_g was stored as text, with one value ("3,075") containing a thousands separator — converted the column to numeric (no values lost).
2. One exact duplicate row (row 61) — removed so no penguin was double-counted.

Checks that passed: species labels match the allowed set (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) with no variants; all body_mass_g values are within the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g; no missing body_mass_g values.

Caveats (not fixed, not relevant to this question): flipper_length_mm has two negative values (-200, -187) that violate the 170–235 mm range, and the sex column has case variants (MALE/FEMALE) and 2 missing values. These columns weren't used for the average, so I left them untouched.
